Both lanes showed the native commentary in a temporary progress message, delivered MANTIS_NATIVE_COMMENTARY_FINAL, and deleted the temporary message. Main's completed chat.history projection kept the commentary only as an unkeyed text block merged into the tool-call message; the candidate returned it as a separate bounded assistant fallback with source=segment and itemId=msg_mantis_native_commentary. This proves the candidate supplies the keyed history presentation contract while preserving Telegram delivery. Both revisions also rendered the commentary twice when the tool line was appended, so that pre-existing Telegram duplication remains and is not fixed by this pull request. - Scenario: `Start each exact-revision Telegram SUT with channels.telegram.streaming.mode=progress and streaming.progress.commentary=true. Install the same SHA-verified provider script: response 1 emits a phased commentary message ('Checking the workspace before answering.') followed by an exec tool call; response 2 emits the delayed final marker. As the real Telegram user, send 'Run the MANTIS native commentary progress scenario.', observe the temporary send/edit/final/delete sequence, then query chat.history for the completed Telegram session before finishing the recorded lane.` - Trigger: `clawsweeper_label` - Run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/32756672646 - Artifact: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/32756672646/artifacts/9531483047 - Baseline: `pass` at `7d08e40e2f1de5e68773032872465e92312eaa13` — Exact baseline 7d08e40e2f1de5e68773032872465e92312eaa13 made 2 provider requests. Telegram sent progress message 50648 with Working plus the commentary, edited it to add a second identical commentary line and Exec blocked, sent final message 50649, then deleted 50648. chat.history returned the commentary as ordinary unkeyed text in the same assistant row as the tool call, with no openclawStreamFallback item identity. - Candidate (PR merged onto main): `pass` at `1f66ce33f38193ccbe17f795d105245ec25acc38` — Exact candidate 1f66ce33f38193ccbe17f795d105245ec25acc38 made 2 provider requests. Telegram sent progress message 50645, edited it with the tool status, sent final message 50646, and deleted 50645. chat.history returned a separate assistant commentary fallback whose openclawStreamFallback had replacementText 'Checking the workspace before answering.', source 'segment', and itemId 'msg_mantis_native_commentary', followed by the tool-call row. The same duplicate commentary line seen on main remained in the edited Telegram progress message. - Differential (trusted facts): The lanes used the same config, prompt, provider script SHA a6bb3bf4a74dc74f710be37aaffee822c5aaec796c924d74317211e55026a31d, and event-file SHA a369ce331b4179bb75ba5f8e3a1c6337d3259419fc5823d25ec93b5a1f986367. Telegram-visible behavior remained equivalent, while only the candidate projected the completed phased commentary into a separately keyed segment fallback. That is the missing shared presentation/history contract described by the pull request, so the fix is demonstrated. The identical two-line commentary edit in both lanes is a surviving pre-existing issue, not evidence against this differential. - Overall: `pass`
